name: Changing a user's reporting manager sends an update email
description:
Objective: Changing a user's reporting manager sends an update email.
Preconditions: Open User lifecycle emails with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open User lifecycle emails.
2. Changing a user's reporting manager sends an update email.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: After a reporting manager is changed from manager_a to manager_b, the affected user must receive a REPORTING_MANAGER_UPDATED email in configured app env.
